content.text:
* Two-stage OTA, NMOS input pair and PMOS output stage
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
XNB IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 m=1
XNT STAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=1 m=2
XN1 D1 VINN STAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=1.2 m=2
XN2 G2 VINP STAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=1.2 m=2
XP1 D1 D1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=2 m=1
XP2 G2 D1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=2 m=1
* Cascoded output current sink
RTOP VDD BN 80k
RBOT BN VSS 120k
XP3 VOUT G2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 m=4
XNC VOUT BN NINT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=4
XN3 NINT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=85.75 l=2 m=8
RZ G2 CINT 3k
CC CINT VOUT 4.5p
.ends DUT
